body:
## Pull request overview

This PR converges the Engine, Protocol, and Client query parameter vocabulary onto QueryAST-standard keys (where/fields/orderBy/limit/offset/expand), deprecating the legacy DataEngineQueryOptions translation layer and removing `toQueryAST()` from the engine.

**Changes:**
- Introduces QueryAST-aligned Engine option schemas/types in `@objectstack/spec` and updates `IDataEngine` to use them.
- Removes Engine-layer query translation (`toQueryAST()`), passing QueryAST-like options directly to drivers.
- Normalizes legacy HTTP query params to QueryAST keys centrally in the protocol handler; updates downstream callers/tests/docs.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 18 out of 18 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts | Adds Engine* QueryAST-aligned option schemas/types; updates contracts and request schemas to the new options; deprecates legacy schemas. |
| packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.test.ts | Adds tests for new Engine* schemas and updates request tests to QueryAST keys. |
| packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts | Updates `IDataEngine` interface (spec) to accept Engine* QueryAST-aligned options. |
| packages/core/src/contracts/data-engine.ts | Updates `IDataEngine` interface (core) to accept Engine* QueryAST-aligned options. |
| packages/objectql/src/engine.ts | Removes `toQueryAST()` and forwards QueryAST-like options directly to drivers; updates update/delete/count/aggregate paths. |
| packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts | Normalizes legacy HTTP query params to QueryAST keys (e.g. filter→where, select→fields, skip→offset, populate→expand). |
| packages/objectql/src/protocol-data.test.ts | Updates protocol normalization tests for the new expand/fields/offset behavior. |
| packages/objectql/src/engine.test.ts | Updates engine expand tests to use QueryAST `expand` instead of legacy `populate`. |
| packages/runtime/src/seed-loader.ts | Migrates seed loader engine queries from select/filter to fields/where. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts | Migrates adapter calls from filter/select/sort/skip to where/fields/orderBy/offset. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.test.ts | Updates adapter test expectations to `where`. |
| packages/client/src/index.ts | Deprecates legacy QueryOptions / `data.find()` and nudges consumers toward QueryAST-based `data.query()`. |
| packages/client/src/client.msw.test.ts | Updates mock server queries to pass `where` into the engine. |
| packages/client/src/client.hono.test.ts | Updates Hono test server queries to pass `where` into the engine. |
| apps/studio/src/lib/create-broker-shim.ts | Migrates broker shim update/delete to `where: { id }`. |
| content/docs/references/data/driver.mdx | Documents `batchSchemaSync` capability in driver capabilities table. |
| content/docs/references/data/data-engine.mdx | Adds Engine* option types and updates several descriptions toward QueryAST-aligned semantics. |
</details>

The RPC request schemas (`DataEngineFindRequestSchema`, `DataEngineFindOneRequestSchema`, etc.) now only accept the new QueryAST-aligned option shapes. Even though the legacy `DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema` is kept and marked deprecated, these request schemas will reject legacy payloads that still send `filter/select/sort/skip/populate`, which undermines the stated backward compatibility for serialized RPC requests. Consider allowing both shapes in the request layer (e.g., `z.union([EngineQueryOptionsSchema, DataEngineQueryOptionsSchema])` with a normalization step), or keep the old request schema fields while deprecating them.
